_comment: Carrier sense taken from the radio, not from the audio. This is NOT a soundmodem.json:
it is ofdm-fm.station.json, and it goes NEXT TO THE DAEMON, because a modem is handed
audio and nothing else and there is nowhere in the daemon's own config to put it.
A station without this file keeps the shipped behaviour and opens no serial port.
busyAboveDbm MUST be measured, not copied. Two nominally identical stations on the
reference bench have idle noise floors 31 dB apart (-94 and -126 dBm). Measure the floor
on a QUIET channel and set a threshold about 15 dB clear of it.
Omit busyAboveDbm to use the radio's hardware DCD alone, which costs no serial traffic.
Be aware DCD reads nothing at all until the first squelch edge, so on a station running
with the squelch held open it may never assert. That is what the RSSI threshold is for.
The radio's data port must be programmed for Command mode (CCDI), and the daemon's user
needs the port: the packaged unit already has SupplementaryGroups=dialout.
With this on, the daemon HOLDS the serial port, so anything else wanting the same port
will fail while it runs. A serial port cannot be opened twice.
